messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: problem with tag
parts:
Hello, 
were your images renamed correctly? It looks like they were.
Also note it is not an error but a warning. So the function did it's work but encountered some unexpected input along the way. Specifically, one of the checks I included gave a warning. I haven't seen that particular issue before, so please feel free to share a test folder to reproduce the problem. Are you using the most recent version?
Best regards,
Jürgen
